welc_scam_t: Never send money before you SEE the house.
welc_scam_d: No deposit, no booking fee, no reservation — nothing. Visit the house first, then pay the landlord directly.
welc_g1: Search — type a city or country in the search bar, or tap Use my location to see vacant houses nearest to you first.
welc_g2: Open & compare — check the photos, rent, deposit, water and electricity on every listing before you chat.
welc_g3: Chat — message the landlord in the app or on WhatsApp. Ask anything — when to view, what is included.
welc_g4: Visit & view — go see the house in daylight, ideally with a friend. A real landlord will welcome this.
welc_g5: Pay only after viewing — deposit and rent go directly to the landlord, never through HuntIn.
welc_f1: Anyone rushing you to send money for a house you have not seen.
welc_f2: “Pay first to book” stories, or rent too cheap for that area.
welc_f3: Refusing a video call or a physical viewing.
welc_report: See a fake listing? Open it and tap Report — every report is reviewed by the admin.
welc_ll_t: Your 4 steps to renting out faster
welc_l1: Get verified — Profile → verification: upload your ID and an ownership photo. The admin approves it, you earn the green badge and 5 listings instead of 2. Renters trust the badge — verified landlords get more chats.
welc_l2: Post your house — tap Post a new listing: 8 quick steps. Pick the country & city, pin your exact gate on the map, add 3+ clear daylight photos.
welc_l3: Boost free — one tap pins your listing at the top for {n} days for every renter browsing your country. Free while HuntIn is new.
welc_l4: Reply fast — houses whose landlord answers quickly rent much faster. Chats land in your Chats tab.
welc_ll_note: Be the landlord renters trust: never ask for money before a viewing, and meet tenants at the house in daylight. HuntIn never collects money on your behalf.

Renters in other countries are not affected unless they search {c} themselves. Boosted listings get the most views and chats.

boost_safety: Rent and deposits are NEVER paid through this platform — always view the house first.

pv_store_d: Your username, name, phone/WhatsApp number, role, and — for landlords — the verification documents you upload. Listing photos and details you post. Chat messages you send. Nothing else. No email, no tracking pixels.
pv_seen_d: Listing content is public. Your phone number is shown to signed-in users on your listings and in chats so renters can reach you. Your verification documents are only visible to the admin. Chats are only visible to you and the other person. If you share your location, it stays on your device — it is never sent to our servers.
pv_rule_d: HuntIn never collects rent, deposit, or any payment. All money matters happen face-to-face after a viewing. If anyone asks you to pay through the app or before a viewing, report them.
pv_data_d: We collect the minimum data needed to run the service. You may ask for your data to be deleted at any time — contact the site admin.
